description: St. Pé, Alexandra and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The completed comparison evaluates remote-sensing turbulence-intensity measurements using 35 datasets contributed by eight organizations. Its engineering purpose is wind-turbine site-suitability assessment. Adjustment methods and reference measurement comparisons are the source-defined analysis. The description presents the TACT tool as forthcoming, so this record does not assert an available TACT implementation. It is one benchmark application with multiple contributing datasets, not 35 independently catalogued datasets whose identities and access routes are unestablished. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. This record represents the documented application and its stated scope. Publication access does not imply that its underlying measurements or implementation are public. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The benchmark is based on comparison of remote-sensing measurements with reference turbulence observations.
